column4: Mid-reset Fleet shows Offline with MDM still On (manual) and connected; nothing marks the reset
Same host ID, new hostname, MDM On; Added to Fleet resets to the re-enrollment time
Two entries per reset: the custom command when sent and MDM turned on; nothing for the reset or re-enrollment
Custom reprovision wipes leave no wipe state; even the built-in Wipe's state is cleared when fleetd re-enrolls, so a reprovision reset needs its own record
